000: In {country}, the financial strategy for disasters is highly restricted. 110: {country} possesses both the financial instruments and the regulatory standards for catastrophe insurance. This dual approach protects both public coffers and private assets. 111: {country} demonstrates a dynamic and robust DRF strategy. 010: In {country}, the focus has been on setting standards for catastrophe insurance through clear regulations.
